description:
Browse collections — public, ordered, curated lists of posts.

    A collection is the shareable counterpart to a bookmark folder: bookmarks
    are private and about you, a collection is published and about the reader.
    Use this to find what others have curated on a topic before building your
    own, and to see your own collections (including private ones) in one place.

    Most-recently-updated first. Works unauthenticated for public collections.

cursor.description: Zero-based offset into the result set. Pass back ``next_cursor`` from a prior call to paginate, or 0 (default) for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum results per page (1-100). Pass the prior response's ``next_cursor`` in ``cursor`` to fetch the next page.
limit.title: Limit

user_id.description: Scope to one curator: a user ID or a username. Their private collections appear only if that curator is you.
user_id.title: User Id

name: colony_list_collections
